summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, run choices, radio tuning and resume location. Shared registries and handlers coordinate global play, while per-place simulations, authored cell scenes and procedural builders compose local spaces and stories. Level 169 combines desert routes, a scheduled cast and frenzied Backrooms Robotics units; Level 178 is Kyoto Dreams, a fixed-morning machiya whose terrain, detailed scene kit and tuned layout data work together.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and deterministic dressing; momentsV gates fitted wall moments and room-prop regeneration.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells. places/testlab is the Test Range with loot/enemy bays and HIT SQUAD pad.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations and Camp Amber crews; fixed tunnel fixtures/furniture are in cell scenes, while sim builds shells/doors and keeps camps staffed.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office, supplies, encounters and story beats.

places/level1 + places/level4 + places/level26 (3D) - M.E.G. camps and authored office mazes; Level 26's S.S. Fun has cabin 23, Partygoer decks/lockdown and aboard gate; Level 1 includes Dina's radio.

places/level9 + places/level11 + places/level61 + places/level70 (3D) - seeded Suburbs, Level 11 city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic and Chapter 2 trail, Snackrooms food court/checkpoint and Froidetown winter market/civic town.

places/level169 (3D, 'Welcome to the Desert') - seeded desert, Ferry's house/trail/pantry/basement, seven scheduled Friends, checkpoints/ship and Field Office 7 with Backrooms Robotics and frenzied units.

places/level178 (3D, 'Kyoto Dreams') - fixed early-morning Class 0 machiya around a courtyard hot spring; generated cell scene holds the detailed structure and kit props, with positions/tuning in scripts/lib/data/level178.yml.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input actions; fall-guard runs before locomotion/player behavior and scripts/radio.js is on the player.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local config, authored placements and place generation/tick behavior; selected sims compose shared helpers.
places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js - seeded height/material generator and desert marks; config binds terrain and scrub dressing, while cell scenes hold placed flora models.

places/level169/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/level169.yml + scripts/lib/l169-house.js + scripts/lib/l169-ferry.js + scripts/lib/l169-friends.js + scripts/lib/l169-road.js + scripts/lib/l169-robotics.js + scripts/l169-outpost-geo.js - dynamic desert house, cast, road, ship and Field Office/robotics systems.

places/level178/config.yaml + scripts/terrain178.js + places/level178/cells/x0z0.scene - terrain entry and ground/pool shape, plus authored machiya structure and fitted kit placements; config selects atmosphere, frozen time and spawn.

scripts/lib/data/level178.yml + art/kyoto/build_arch.py + art/kyoto/build_props.py - Kyoto layout/tuning source and Blender asset builders; art/kyoto/assets.txt catalogs the kit, while built models are placed in the scene.

places/level13/cells/x0z0.scene + places/level13/sim.js - cell scene owns apartment shell and permanent architectural fixtures; sim handles lethargy and delegates furnishing, foes, people, dressing and tape.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - title/settings, new-expedition choices, five-slot save manager and story/tutorial lifecycle; scripts/ui.js composes the in-game HUD and wrist panels.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical per-place names, labels and HUD titles, including Level 178 / Kyoto Dreams; consumed by feed, quest names and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/caching/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 path adapters.

scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - common pursuit/lurk/wake/retreat/bite behavior configured by scripts/lib/l34-smiler.js and scripts/lib/l9-smiler.js; scripts/lib/carry.js + scripts/lib/companion.js transfer held props/followers and manage co-located followers.
scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts and scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - separate Bonus shared-room routing and The Hub tunnel/door/key registry.
scripts/lib/containment.js - Level 109 persistent pen/loose-foe, open-door and remembered-door-position books; sim supplies room IDs/boxes and spawnFoe adapter.

scripts/lib/pg-society.js + scripts/lib/data/pg-society.yml - Level 26 Partygoer role/routes, sight-bound relay and deck alert/search/recovery; scripts/partygoers.js reads rules and owns actor behavior/traps.

scripts/lib/npc-gear.js + scripts/lib/fresh-aura.js - shared NPC leveled gear/wear/pocket rolls and Reality Freshener radius check; meg-agent, hit squads, player and remodel quest reuse these helpers.

scripts/lib/radio.js + scripts/lib/data/radio*.yml - shared clocked station list/segment timing used by the HALOGEN wrist radio, scripts/world-radio.js physical radios and scripts/radio-ui.js; Kyoto Dreams Radio is a station.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; per-level path adapters retain level-specific cell/block rules and exports.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js expose update with separate configurations.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.
scripts/lib/quests.js - shared journal/advancement/reward helpers; containment.js - containment state/pen/door operations; ch2-quest.js - Chapter 2 stages and dialogue helpers.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js - OPTS, DEFAULTS, PICK_DEFAULTS, RATE, PRESETS, runOf, needsMul, sanityMul, noStory, noNpcs, cleanPick, KEEP, SKIP; scripts/main-menu.js - SLOTS.

scripts/lib/radio.js - STATIONS, STATION, stationOf, onAir; scripts/lib/l169-friends.js - stopsOf, planAt, slateText, layFriends, tickFriends; l169-house.js - layTrail, layHouse; l169-robotics.js - layRobotics, roboTick; scripts/terrain178.js - heightAt, materialAt.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, currency and related player progress.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats derived stats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates the xpCurve progression model.

scripts/lib/modifiers.js - player.state bookBonuses/readBooks/genericBooksRead/effects and modifier derivation; scripts/lib/clothes.js owns worn gear records whose passive modifiers feed the modifier engine.

scripts/lib/manuals.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.recipes stores learned recipe IDs; legacy player.state.manuals still grants all recipes of those kinds. Using a manual token learns one unknown recipe of its kind.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - player.state.run owns expedition picks; run options determine story/NPC presence and hunger/thirst/sanity drain multipliers.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - SQL saves table owns named save-slot snapshots by player owner and slot; player.state remains the live/current run state.
scripts/radio.js - player.state.radioOn/radioSt retain tuned station and power; radioOpen is the current wrist-tab state, with stream/hush object IDs kept in session.

Level 169: l169-friends.js owns live cast schedule/hostility/chatter; l169-robotics.js owns unit schedule and credits quest kills in player.state.l169bot/l169botK; scripts/lib/data/level169.yml owns robot timing, variants, paint, weapons, crew and rules.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV and radio behaviors; scripts/interact.js finds focusable tagged props and dispatches their handlers.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js update before movement; place changes hold velocity for ground streaming, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.

scripts/main-menu-ui.js actions → scripts/main-menu.js → player.state.run or SQL saves; new-run reset uses run-opts KEEP/SKIP and options gate story/tutorial lifecycle; load resolves destination through wakePlace.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js → main-menu story gates Dina/Chapter 2/cutscenes; global sim.js removes tagged NPCs only when every player in a place chose noNpcs, and Phoebe only when every player chose noStory; needsMul feeds crafting and survival drains.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold door handlers call carryAcross → held props and nearby following companions cross; Bonus/world/room links are excluded.
scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone; scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles, markers and compass place names, including Level 178.

scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js place-matched jobs; carried items/kills/world events advance errands and quest dialogue handlers → journal, player.state.errands/qtrack, feed, reputation and rewards.
scripts/lib/data/craft.yml food recipes consume raw meat or carried snack IDs and produce IDs defined in snacks.yml; scripts/lib/manuals.js gates recipe learning through player.state.recipes.

places/level169/config.yaml → scripts/terrain169.js terrain and flora; places/level169/sim.js lays versioned level169.yml setpieces and ticks Friends/road/S.S. Fun/quest/robotics; l169-robotics.js reads robot rules/variants and spawns dressed cat-body frenzied units.

l169-robotics.js puts the complete worn outfit in each robot's body.state.look and builds its critter body from that look → critter-model/cat-wardrobe renders the chassis and hat, while shared NPC look/clothes handling can read the worn equipment.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; menus/staff vary by venue and Level 6.1 fixtures are fitted separately.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes a table with separately fitted chairs.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/ballistics.js + scripts/lib/knock.js - weapon stats/variants share combat; per-weapon sound/rack/reload fields resolve through sounds.yml, with weapon-specific liquid effects.

art/cigs/build.py + art/fnv/build.py + art/xmas-clean/build.py and NIF converters, plus art/cat-wardrobe/fit.py + tailclear.py + art/level70-stall/parts.py - fitted GLBs/prop catalogs and body-specific garment/prop fitting.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.

scripts/lib/l169-road.js + scripts/lib/l169-road-geo.js + scripts/lib/l169-travel.js + scripts/lib/l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards facing their approach and animated gates.

art/kyoto/build_arch.py + build_props.py + kit.py + scripts/lib/data/level178.yml - authored machiya architecture and prop kit share Blender helpers and layout positions; varied shoji/fusuma, rooms, spring, kitchen, lanterns and furnishings assemble into the Level 178 scene.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs, destinations and coordinates together. The Hub cells own fixed fixture/furniture IDs; keep matching scene placements with them.

Level 13's building shell is authored in cells/x0z0.scene; sim.js returns if l13-floor is absent and no longer regenerates the shell. Preserve matching floor ID and scene wall/threshold geometry; LETH remains in player.state.leth13.

Level 169 uses x/z with north at -z and 1:10 map scale; terrain marks, track, house, road sites, Field Office 7 and ship berth must align. level169.yml holds tuned positions/rules; sim layout version and well version are separate.

Faulty Units uses player.state.l169bot/l169botK and place.state.botNext/botSeq; kill credit is a 50 m radius and requires three credited kills. Keep robot rules/variant paint in level169.yml and preserve each robot's full worn outfit in body.state.look for model rendering and gear handling.

Level 178 positions in scripts/lib/data/level178.yml use metres, north = -Z, house floor y=0.45; keep the authored cell placements and hot-spring basin aligned with scripts/terrain178.js ground pool cut (y=-1.7) and courtyard/path thresholds.
